name: Douglas Schoch

tagline: Engineering interactive web applications, automated spatial data pipelines, and exploratory dashboards across environmental systems, real-time telemetry, 3D cartography, and digital humanities.
bio: I build interactive Web GIS applications, spatial data pipelines, and custom exploratory tools.
